content_of_post_to_answer: Does this make me one sick girl? My step brother my age comes in my room at night to help me with my homework. He is only wearing his shorts with his dong hanging out. I get excited. *********************?
answer: Feeling aroused by a situation does not automatically define your character, but the situation itself matters. A person entering your room exposed and creating sexual tension crosses a boundary, especially in a family relationship where trust and safety should come first. Attraction and actions are different things; noticing a feeling is not the same as choosing to act on it. I've written more about how people can separate confusing feelings from healthy boundaries on my profile, if you want to explore that distinction further. The most important question is not “what does this feeling make me?” but “what kind of situation am I allowing around me?”
